newsitem.title: TURKEY: Village guard dead in Turkish landmine explosion.
newsitem.headline: Village guard dead in Turkish landmine explosion.

text.p: A member of an anti-guerrilla militia in southeast Turkey died on Sunday when the tractor he was travelling in hit a landmine sown by Kurdish rebels, security officials said.
Two civilians were also injured in the incident in the province of Diyarbakir. The guard was delivering food to a police post, the officials said.
Turkey pays and arms around 70,000 village guards to fight Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas in the southeast. Both sides plant mines.

A policeman was killed in the southeastern town of Kurtalan when a rocket he was carrying exploded in his hands on Saturday, security officials in the city of Diyarbakir said. Three policemen were wounded.
More than 21,000 people have been killed in the 12-year-old conflict between Turkish security forces and the PKK, fighting for Kurdish autonomy or independence.
